agentTools.title: Diagnose a rollout
agentTools.description: Diagnoses one Argo Rollout in a single call: its phase and step; the Deployment its template comes from (spec.workloadRef — 0 replicas of such a Deployment is normal); its ReplicaSets and pod template hashes; where canary and stable traffic really go (the Istio VirtualService routes, the DestinationRule subsets and the canary and stable Services, resolved to template hashes and available pods); its analysis runs with the failing measurements, and the weak spots of its analysis templates (passing on NaN or without data, unable to fail, run dry); and a timeline of conditions, pauses, analyses and events. Findings are judged in context: the same hash for stable and canary is a problem only while an update runs and the canary has weight. Give the Rollout's name, or a Deployment's to find the Rollout that uses it. Changes nothing; what could not be read is listed in notChecked.

ko.name: Argo Rollouts
ko.description: Argo Rollouts: 단계, 가중치, ReplicaSet, 분석 실행이 있는 rollout. kubectl argo rollouts와 똑같은 패치를 먼저 보여 준 뒤 승격, 중단, 다시 시도, 일시 중지, 재개를 수행합니다. 저하되거나 중단된 rollout, 오래 일시 중지된 rollout, 분석 결론이 나지 않은 rollout, 실패한 분석, 카나리에 닿지 않는 카나리 트래픽을 문제로 표시합니다. 카나리가 얼마나 안전하게 설정되었는지 선택적으로 검사합니다. Deployment를 템플릿으로 쓰는 Rollout을 보여 줍니다. AI 에이전트를 위한 읽기 전용 진단 도구도 제공합니다.
